messages:
Maria Chen: Launch next Wed — need final X + LinkedIn scheduling, split-test plan, and assets by Monday EOD.
Noah Patel: On it. Primary KPI = webinar signups, secondary = product page visits.
Maria Chen: Correct. Test short punchy copy vs storytelling thread.
Devon Yamaguchi: I'll build variants: X short (single tweet) vs X thread (3 tweets). LinkedIn: long single post vs carousel.
Olivia Hart: Asset list: hero (1200x675), 1:1 preview, 16:9 video card. Upload to Drive and tag design.
Maria Chen: Drive link (placeholder) https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/launch-assets  Upload deadline Mon 6pm PT. Also add UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_q2; utm_source=x|linkedin; utm_content=short|thread.
Noah Patel: Suggest UTMs: `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=short` and `...&utm_content=thread` for the other.
Devon Yamaguchi: Draft copy (please thumbs up for chosen variants):
A_X_short: "Redwood Inference: faster, predictable LLM inference. Join our launch webinar for benchmarks + live demo  redwood.ai/signup #LLM #inference"
B_X_thread_1: "Serving LLMs is the new competitive moat. 1/3"
B_X_thread_2: "Latency + cost + reliability: what matters in production. 2/3"
B_X_thread_3: "See benchmarks + demo — register: redwood.ai/signup 3/3"
LI_long: "We built Redwood Inference to make production LLMs predictable and economical. Join our launch webinar for benchmarks, deployment options, and cost levers teams can use today. RSVP: redwood.ai/signup"
Olivia Hart: Proposed schedule (PT): Day 0: X short 10:00, LI long 12:00. Day 2: X thread 11:00 (if chosen). Day 4: repost + $500 boost for top creative at 09:00. Day 7: testimonial clip 15:00.
Maria Chen: Budget confirmed $500 first week. Audience: developers, ML engineers, platform leads.
Noah Patel: Will split-boost A/B 60/40 and set UTMs accordingly.
Devon Yamaguchi: Need copy + assets sign-off by Tue 11:00 so SocialSchedBot can queue.
SocialSchedBot: Reminder: queue with `/schedule post` and folder ID. Cron window 08:00-13:00 PT.
Olivia Hart: Tagging design and ops. I'll ping when assets are in Drive.
Maria Chen: Post-launch ops: 1) reply scripts for comments; 2) 24h retargeting audience of page visitors; 3) post-webinar highlight clip for LI.
Noah Patel: Reply script example: "Thanks! Register here: redwood.ai/signup  DM for an enterprise demo."
Devon Yamaguchi: I'll add 3 comment templates to the Drive.
Olivia Hart: Anything else?
Maria Chen: Please react with :white_check_mark: once copy + assets are final. Thanks! :tada:
